translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: 2 Corintios
book.title: An tsabchilab u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic ti Corinto c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pablo

content: A Pablo in thuchanchal an u an tamcunel ebchalab ti Corinto

Nana’its im Pablo tin abathualejil a Jesucristo, cum antsana’ pel in culbetal a Dios tiquim bijiy. Nana’ ani u ebchal c’al a Cristo Timoteo tu tsapnethalchic. Nan tu thuchanchal axe’ xi u ebchalabchic ax it ajith ti al an tamcunel ebchalab ti bichou Corinto, ani jaye patal jitats pel in c’al a Dios ax u c’uajilchic ti bichoulom Acaya.
U lej le’ abal i Tata Dios ani i Ajatic Jesucristo ti lubach co’onchichic a ichich c’al in alhua’ inictal ani ti jun ejetbethanchi a ichich.
Yajchicnax a Pablo
C’ac’namal yan a Dios axi pel in Tata i Ajatic Jesucristo, cum ja’its jaja’ i Tata Dios ax tu yajnanchal ani ets’ey tu culbethanchal i ichich.

Ja’its a Dios ax tu culbethanchal i ichich c’al patal jahuaquitsq’ui qui yajchicna’, abal qui ejtou qui culbethanchihue in ichich q’ue’atchic ax in yajchicnal jaye. Qui culbethanchi in ichich jaja’chic jant’ini’ huahua’ i ichich culbethanchamejits c’al a Dios.
Max i lej yajchicnal ejtil a Cristo in yajchicnamal, bel jaja’ tu lej culbethanchal i ichich.

Max i yajchicnal ani a Dios tu culbethanchal i ichich jats abal qui ejtou tu culbethanchi tata’chic a ichich ani tu tolmiy quit lo’panchic c’al a Dios. Jaja’ ne’ets ti tolmiychic ca cuxuy c’al i c’aya’talab an yajchictalab axi huahua’ jaye i yajchicnal.
Lej thacat i ichich, cum i tso’obits abal a Dios ne’ets ti culbethanchichic a ichich ma ju’tamits huichat ca yajchicna’.
Ebchalabchic, nan u lej tu tso’obliy abal i lej yajchicnamal yan i yajchictalab ti bichoulom Asia, ma hue’its yabats cu tsapne qui cuxuy. I ulu ti ichich max hualam cu talabetha.

I tsalpay abal max hualam im bajumalits an hora cu lej tsemthajits t’ajat. Antsana’ tu jila’ a Dios qui yajchicna’ abal qui lej tsapna’ jaja’ ani yab qui tsapna’ ti cuete’ ba’. In lej cua’al in tsap a Dios, ma in ejtohual quin ejtha’ an tsemelomchic.
Ja’its jaja’ a Dios ax tu lej jec’ontha’ tam ti hue’its ne’etsac cu tsemtha. Ma xohue’ tu jec’onthale ani ma abal ets’ey i aychal tucu jec’onthaye.

Ne’ets tucu jec’onthaye biyat tata’chic tucu conchinchi i alhua’talab. Max yan i ebchalabchic tu conchinchale i alhua’talab c’al a Dios, jaye yan i ebchalabchic ne’ets quim bina’ i c’ac’namal yan c’al a Dios tam quin tsu’u abal a Dios ets’ey tu jec’onthal.
Yab in ejtou a Pablo ca c’ale thubat ti Corinto

In lej culbel cum u ats’al thacat tu ichich c’al u xe’tsintal. In xe’tsinenec t’ocat ani tequeth, cum tu tolmiyal a Dios c’al in alhua’ inictal antsana’ quin xe’tsin. U lej t’aja ti cuenta quin xe’tsin bolith tam tin c’uajatac c’al tata’chic.
Cum huahua’ tu lejquith thuchanchal an cau a ejtohualchic ca ajiy ani ca lejquith ejtiy. U lej le’ abal ca tala’ ejtiy jahua’ nan tu thuchanchal.

Xohue’ tata’chic huachic tin ejtinchamalits u xe’tsintal, ani u lej le’ac abal talbelaquits tam quim baju a q’uicha ca huichiy i Ajatic Jesús cu junax culbe ani yab cu tithebetha tin cuenta i xe’tsintal.
Cum huahua’ u ejtix jun c’al xi jun u q’uejab tsalpay tu tsa’biy tsab i calel, ani antsana’ tata’chic tiquin tabatnanchi axi tsabil i calat i tsa’bixtalab.
Quim peley c’al tata’chic tam in ne’etsac Macedonia ani jaye junil tam in ne’etsac Judea. U lej le’ac max tata’chic tiquin tolminchi hue’ c’al am bel abal quin c’ale ti Judea.

Auxe’ max in jalc’u’ cum yab u ejtou tu tsa’biychic tsabil i calel jant’ini’ u oc’ox tsalpay ne’ets cu t’aja’. Hualam max tata’chic tin tsalpanchal nana’ne u ey jahuaquits tam inic cu q’uet’ach ulu ojni’ in ne’ets ani tu lej ichich iba.
U punuhual a Dios ti cau abal yab ne’ets tu q’uet’ach ucha’ ojni’ in ne’ets ani tu lej ichich iba.

A Silvano ani a Timoteo ani nana’ tam u c’uajatac c’al tata’chic tu lej t’iloxnanchi in ey a Jesucristo in Tsacamil a Dios. Jaja’ ni jayq’ui’ yab in q’uet’ach ulal i cau ojni’ ne’ets quin t’aja’ ani tin lej ichich iba. Ets’ey in t’ajal an chubaxtalab jahua’ quin ulu.

C’al jahua’ in t’ajal a Cristo jats tu putnal patal jahua’ im bijchith ulumalits a Dios ne’ets quin t’aja’. Cum in ey a Cristo ets’ey in t’ajal jahua’ chubax, jaxtam i ulal Amén tam i c’ac’nal a Dios.
Ja’its a Dios ax tu ts’at’bamalits c’al a Cristo ani tu tsapliyal abal qui putu i uchbil. Jats a Dios ax tu pithamalits i eylabil.

Tu ts’o’mayamalits ti lej ichich c’al im bij cum pelits tu c’al. Tu pithamalits an Espíritu Santo abal tucu c’uajchiy i ichich, ani jaxtam i alhua’ tso’ob abal a Dios lej chubax ne’ets tucu pitha’ patal jahua’ im bijchith ulumalits ne’ets tucu pitha’.
U punuhual a Dios ti cau abal yabaye in c’ale c’al tata’chic ti Corinto cum yab u le’ tu c’olchichic a ichich c’al a ey. Alhua’ max quin t’ajat tsemets max yab chubax jahua’ tu uchalchic.
Yab u le’ tu c’unat ucha’chic jahua’ a uchbil ca bela’, cum a junini’ belalits an chubaxtalab. Expith u le’ tu tolmiy quit jum putat culbechic c’al an Ajatic.
